profile.headline: AI Software Engineer @ GeoComply
profile.summary:
AI/ML engineer with hands-on experience deploying production-grade intelligent systems across geolocation fraud detection, legal contract analysis, and NLP applications.
Action-first developer who takes full ownership of projects while fostering collaborative innovation.
Open to opportunities in AI/ML engineering where I can build intelligent systems that create meaningful business impact.

positions.title: AI Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Accelerate development velocity using Cursor to generate production-ready, unit-tested code
- Migrate critical microservices from PHP to Golang, optimizing concurrency performance and latency
- Refactor legacy codebase implementing clean architecture patterns, improving code maintainability with comprehensive API documentation
- Collaborate with senior engineers on scalable, portable API design, enhancing developer experience
- Prevent digital crime and fight location fraud in helping businesses achieve regulatory compliance
positions.insights: Skills: Cursor · Migration · Software Design · Go (Programming Language) · Team Coordination

positions.title: AI Full-Stack Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Fine-tuned transformer models (DeepSeek) to extract legal entities and relationships from contracts
- Developed data pipelines and schema design for LLM-generated legal framework analysis
- Optimized cloud infrastructure (Groq) for high-performance inference reducing computational costs
- Implemented responsive UI/UX components delivering intuitive contract analysis dashboards
- Maintained production-grade codebase ensuring scalability and comprehensive test coverage
positions.insights: Skills: Machine Learning · Data Models · Web Development · Collaborative Problem Solving · Creative Strategy

positions.title: Lead AI Full-Stack Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Architected and deployed end-to-end AI-integrated personality assessment platform using React
- Engineered prompt engineering workflows with OpenAI GPT-4o for dynamic quiz generation 
- Built RESTful API integrations with OpenAI services, implementing efficient request handling
- Developed Foryu/Oto AI Character Selector webapp featuring predictive search algorithms
- Delivered comprehensive QA testing for AI desktop characters, ensuring seamless user experience
positions.insights: Skills: REST APIs · React.js · Full-Stack Development

positions.title: Machine Learning Developer for AI-based Therapy
positions.description:
Researched, implemented, and tested Carebot, an AI-powered chatbot that replicates real-world conversations between therapists and patients using RASA framework and ML.
Carebot serves to make mental health services and therapy more accessible and affordable to everyone by providing a user-friendly website that offers free AI-based therapeutic conversations, mental health advice, and support.
positions.insights: Skills: Data Structures · Machine Learning · Project Planning · Collaborative Problem Solving · Rasa Platform · Research Skills

company.name: Data Analysis & Intelligent Systems, University of Washington Bothell

positions.title: CSE 14x (Intro to Java) Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Helped teach introductory Java to college students.

- Led 1-2 weekly sections of about 10-15 students to explain Java concepts using analogy-based, visual, conceptual and code-based explanations to ensure everyone can reach a strong level of understanding.

- Provided vital 1-on-1 support to dozens of students (from the entire class) in weekly office hours through encouragement and calm, clear and simple explanations, as well as detailed 1-on-1 feedback on student assignments explaining how they can improve their code behavior, abstraction and design, correct use of concepts, and code readability.

- Actively contributed suggestions to and asked clarifying questions during weekly staff meetings regarding grading student assignments and developing lesson plans.

Topics taught include:
- complex data structures such as binary trees and linked lists
- recursive and iterative implementations of essential algorithms, Java objects, classes, inheritance and interfaces
- industry-standard code styling and code quality conventions
- file processing and scanners to store, retrieve and display data, key applications of loops, conditionals, arrays, parameters and returns
- efficient code structuring to maintain high performance and readability.
positions.insights: Skills: Team Coordination · Grading · Data Structures · Debugging Code · Teaching · Presentation Skills · Core Java

company.name: Paul G. Allen School of Computer Science & Engineering

volunteerExperiences.description:
Implemented new features and resolved bugs in the Trafficking Interrupt Resource Agent (TIRA) with a team of developers at Microsoft and the University of Washington.

TIRA is a website that serves to get victims of human trafficking the resources they need to recover and restore their well-being by making it quick and easy to contact a large network of service providers, and making it quick and easy for service providers to display services for victims.

Directed and organized new developers and students to get excited, organized and ready for IMPACT++, a student organization that codes for social good.

Led a coding bootcamp (with a handbook written by me) that helps new software developers learn the important skills of collaborating, communicating, and coordinating with other software developers, and learn the SwE mindset that there is always more to learn and that growth is more important than perfection.
